STEP 1 - Scene: This looks like a stir-fried beef dish with greens (likely basil or similar leafy herb) and red chili pieces, served on a white square plate. Photographed from above at a near-overhead angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The white plate is roughly square, about 26 cm across its width. Area ≈ 26 x 26 ≈ 600 cm² (treating it as a dinner plate, roughly 530 cm² if circular-equivalent). I'll use ~550 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Stir-fried beef slices (main component)
- Cooked greens/herbs (basil-like leaves)
- Red chili pieces
- Small amount of oil/sauce sheen and possibly some rice or onion bits mixed in

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, ~550 cm²):
- Beef: 22% ≈ 121 cm²
- Greens/herbs: 8% ≈ 44 cm²
- Chili and aromatics: 2% ≈ 11 cm²
- Total food coverage ≈ 32%, which fits a compact pile in the center.

STEP 5 - Volume (outer envelope height):
- Beef: 121 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 180 ml
- Greens: 44 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 88 ml
- Chili/aromatics: 11 cm² x 1 cm ≈ 11 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Beef: 180 ml x 0.9 ≈ 162 g
- Greens: 88 ml x 0.15 ≈ 13 g
- Chili/aromatics: 11 ml x 0.5 ≈ 6 g
- Oil/sauce sheen: ~3 g

STEP 7 - Energy (cooked weight):
- Beef (stir-fried, lean-medium): 162 g x 250 kcal/100g ≈ 405 kcal
- Greens: 13 g x 25 kcal/100g ≈ 3 kcal
- Chili/aromatics: 6 g x 40 kcal/100g ≈ 2 kcal
- Oil/sauce: 3 g x 880 kcal/100g ≈ 26 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The visible pile is a modest portion, roughly 184 g total, which is plausible for a single serving of stir-fried beef with greens. It is less than a fully covered plate, consistent with the 32% coverage estimate. Total ≈ 436 kcal.
